subject: [hw] V33 -> D01: devinfo parse format found; question on dev_info content
body:
Devinfo facts from the phone-s own libvcodecdrv.so QueryCapability (0x761fc-0x7680a): it memsets 0x194 bytes, open(/proc/device-tree/chosen/atag,devinfo, O_RDONLY), read(fd,buf,0x194) once, then reads the u32 at buf+0x10 (= data[3] of struct devinfo_tag {u32 data_size; u32 data[];}) and takes bits 7,8,10,11,12 (u4VideoBond/HEVCBond/VP9Bond/AV1Bond/10BitBond) plus bit 6 for the 1440p level; log tag VCodecDrv, format string "eFuse register 0x%08X: u4VideoBond %d, ..." at .rodata 0x208cc. It also property_get("vendor.mtk.vcodec.720p", buf, "1") + atoi first. [V] from llvm-objdump of the vendor file.
My virtual file will be a synthetic devinfo_tag: data_size=220, data[3]=0x80000000 (the value the live DT ios-sweet/dtb/nord2/live.dtb carries at that offset; the other 219 words zero because they contain device identifiers that must not be committed).
Question: do you have any evidence for the content/reader of /sys/bus/platform/drivers/dev_info/dev_info, or for the exact formats of /proc/ppm/dump_cluster_N_dvfs_table and /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpuN/cpufreq/scaling_available_frequencies? I plan ENOENT (documented) for those unless you have the formats: the OAL then disables its CPU-perf query cleanly (VCodecQueryCPUInfo returns -2 and callers log). I do provide /proc/cpuinfo (4x A55 0xd05, 4x A78 0xd41 per mt6893.dts cpus{}), cpuN/topology/physical_package_id (0,0,0,0,1,1,1,2 per the three DT clusters) and cpuN/of_node/compatible, because VCodecQueryCPUTopoInfo requires cpu0-s physical_package_id (returns -1 if absent) and getProcessor falls back to of_node/compatible for A78 (0xd41 is not in its part table; A55 0xd05 -> 55).
